description: Evaluate an expression in a session, as %eval does: a literal, a declared feature or qualified name, an enumeration literal, a unit, or a compound expression over the session's declarations. Returns the value as data and as the prompt prints it.

expression.description: a SysML expression: a literal, a feature or qualified name, or a compound expression over the session's declarations

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

name: session_eval

text.description: the value as the prompt prints it

value.description: the value in the runtime API's JSON form (opensysml.v1.Value): a typed scalar, sequence, set, instance reference or function
